requirements.statement: Each cryptic content (ASCII art, emoticon, cryptic syntax) has an alternative by one of the listed means.

citations.quote: Dans chaque page web, chaque contenu cryptique (art ASCII, émoticône, syntaxe cryptique) vérifie-t-il une de ces conditions ?
chaque contenu cryptique (art ASCII, émoticône, syntaxe cryptique) a-t-il une alternative ?

routes.statement: A definition is available through a title attribute, for example on a link, a form control or an abbr element.

citations.quote: Soit une définition est disponible au moyen d’un attribut `title`, sur un lien, un contrôle de formulaire, une abréviation (élément `<abbr>`) par exemple

routes.statement: A definition is given by the adjacent context, immediately before or after the content.

citations.quote: Une définition est donnée par le contexte adjacent.
Soit une définition est donnée dans le contexte adjacent (immédiatement avant ou après).

rationale.text: The test has one requirement with two routes. Which content is cryptic is judgment: the wording gives three kinds by example (ASCII art, emoticons, cryptic syntax) and no definition, and no glossary entry is linked. A pattern could find some text emoticons such as ":-)", but not ASCII art or cryptic syntax in general, so a list of candidates could never be shown complete. Even for a candidate found, the second route asks whether the text immediately before or after defines it, which is a reading of meaning. A missing title attribute therefore proves nothing, and no check is linked: the entry is none. No axe rule is tagged for this test. Applicability is judgment: whether the page holds cryptic content at all is the same judgment. Needs is empty.

citations.quote: Retrouver dans le document les contenus cryptiques (art ASCII, émoticône, syntaxe cryptique)
